links.idiom: DeskClient (agent-console/src/deskClient.ts) keeps the base URL in a private field (from config.deskUrl <- DESK_URL env, passed in cli.ts), each method builds its path and calls the private generic send() which does fetch(this.baseUrl + path); literal path '/api/tickets'; receiver path = APIRouter(prefix='/api') in main.py + APIRouter(prefix='/tickets') in api/tickets.py + route ''

DeskClient (agent-console/src/deskClient.ts) keeps the base URL in a private field (from config.deskUrl <- DESK_URL env, passed in cli.ts), each method builds its path and calls the private generic send() which does fetch(this.baseUrl + path); template path `/api/tickets${qs}` with a URLSearchParams query string; receiver path = APIRouter(prefix='/api') in main.py + APIRouter(prefix='/tickets') in api/tickets.py + route ''

DeskClient (agent-console/src/deskClient.ts) keeps the base URL in a private field (from config.deskUrl <- DESK_URL env, passed in cli.ts), each method builds its path and calls the private generic send() which does fetch(this.baseUrl + path); template path with encodeURIComponent(id); receiver path = APIRouter(prefix='/api') in main.py + APIRouter(prefix='/tickets') in api/tickets.py + route '/{ticket_id}' (ticket resolved by a Depends(load_ticket) dependency)

DeskClient (agent-console/src/deskClient.ts) keeps the base URL in a private field (from config.deskUrl <- DESK_URL env, passed in cli.ts), each method builds its path and calls the private generic send() which does fetch(this.baseUrl + path); template path `/api/tickets/${id}/reply`; receiver path = APIRouter(prefix='/api') in main.py + APIRouter(prefix='/tickets') in api/tickets.py + route '/{ticket_id}/reply'

DeskClient (agent-console/src/deskClient.ts) keeps the base URL in a private field (from config.deskUrl <- DESK_URL env, passed in cli.ts), each method builds its path and calls the private generic send() which does fetch(this.baseUrl + path); same template path as H3 but method 'PATCH' passed as the first argument of send(); receiver path = APIRouter(prefix='/api') in main.py + APIRouter(prefix='/tickets') in api/tickets.py + route '/{ticket_id}'

Server-Sent Events subscription: DeskClient.eventsUrl() returns new URL('/api/events/stream', this.baseUrl), handed to a LiveFeed (EventEmitter) whose open() does fetch(this.url, {accept: text/event-stream}) and parses the streamed body; receiver is a FastAPI StreamingResponse (media_type text/event-stream) at APIRouter(prefix='/api') + APIRouter(prefix='/events') + '/stream'

Redis stream: desk does redis.asyncio XADD (self._redis.xadd(self._stream, fields, maxlen=...)) with the stream name from pydantic-settings (DESK_TRIAGED_STREAM, default 'desk.tickets.triaged'); analytics reads it with ioredis xreadgroup('GROUP', group, consumer, ..., 'STREAMS', this.cfg.stream, '>') where the stream name comes from loadConfig() (TRIAGED_STREAM env, same default), consumer group created with XGROUP CREATE MKSTREAM

httpx.AsyncClient(base_url=settings.openrouter_url) built in a class constructor, POST to the module constant DECISIONS_PATH; base URL from pydantic-settings field default 'https://openrouter.ai'; invoked from a FastAPI BackgroundTasks task (Jev typesafe/jev-1.14 noul decisions)

official openai Python SDK: AsyncOpenAI(base_url=settings.openrouter_base_url = 'https://openrouter.ai/api/v1') and client.chat.completions.create(model='openai/gpt-4o-mini', max_tokens=120, ...); no URL path appears in the call, the SDK appends /chat/completions

global fetch(this.endpoint, {method: 'POST', body: JSON}) in a reporter class; the full URL 'https://httpbin.org/post' is a config default (REPORT_URL env) passed to the constructor; flushed on a setInterval timer and on SIGTERM
